message.content: A magazine cover features the red masthead "TEMPO" across the top. Above it, on a red background, are the yellow words "Wawancara Eksklusif Mahathir Mohamad". Below the masthead, small black text reads "EDISI 9-15 Februari 2004". The central illustration depicts a human head with glasses and a smiling expression emerging from a yellow, rabbit-shaped toy costume. The yellow figure has long ears, a round body, and a white puff tail. The figure holds a white circular drum with a blue rim; on the drum skin is a green and yellow pentagonal logo featuring a tree. A small red object rests at the bottom of the drum. A hand from the left edge holds a small gavel, positioned as if about to strike the back of the yellow figure. Large black text to the right reads "Terus, Terus, dan...". The bottom left corner has a barcode and number "D0050". The bottom right displays "Rp 14.700". The background is a plain, light-colored surface.
